text:
nina_cs: AuroraEdge onboarding smoke test failed: audit logs not appearing in S3 and our ingest can't decrypt KMS-wrapped payloads. They need evidence for SOC report by EOD.

lee_netops: Quick look shows VPC endpoint policy denies s3:PutObject from CloudTrail principal. Also CloudTrail delivery prefix is set to /audits_old/.

raj_se: KMS key alias is alias/ae-audit (customer-owned). Our role only has kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood/audit. Two options: request alias change or grant explicit key ARN permissions. Prefer ARN to avoid touching customer aliases.

emily_sec: If we add ARN permissions, require written consent and add condition kms:CallerAccount to limit scope. Log all changes to CS-4750.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-4750 created by emily_sec. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4750

nina_cs: Plan: lee fixes endpoint & prefix, raj will push staged KMS permission for ARN, emily drafts consent text, I'll inform AM and mark renewal watch. All agree?

lee_netops: Updating endpoint policy now. ETA 10m. Will add temporary lifecycle rule to avoid object deletion.

raj_se: Staging change applied; test decrypt passed for redwood-ingest role. Will not apply to prod until emily sign-off.

emily_sec: Sign-off given with condition on kms:CallerAccount. Please record change in CS-4750 and attach CloudTrail event IDs.

ops-bot: Action: prod KMS grant applied by raj_se at 2026-03-22T09:12:45Z

lee_netops: Prefix corrected to /audits_redwood/; sample object head: {Key: "audits_redwood/2026/03/22/0001.json", Size: 1987}.

nina_cs: Verification checklist: 1) S3 object present in new prefix, 2) ingest decrypts, 3) CloudTrail shows KMS decrypt event. Who will post evidence?

raj_se: I'll post KMS event IDs and decrypt logs.

emily_sec: I'll upload audit screenshots and consent email to CS-4750. Enablement note follow-up: I'll draft key-rotation steps and verification commands, ETA 24h.

nina_cs: Thanks everyone. Marking audit onboarding as resolved for now. Renewal status: watch -> mitigated pending enablement. Closing loop with customer.
